title: Atlassian security advisory (AV26-1166)
description: As of November 17, 2026, Atlassian is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
Jira Service Management Data Center
	Version 10.3.27 and prior
Version 11.3.13 and prior

Jira Service Management Server
	Versions 5.12.16 to 5.12.42
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
